jobs.name: daily-digest
jobs.prompt:
Generate today's daily summary using daily-digest skill (v2 Linear-style renderer with cover page, TOC, stat boxes, ASCII bar charts, Msyh font). After writing the markdown file, run the renderer:
 python 'C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\Local\hermes\hermes-agent\skills\daily-digest\references\daily_renderer.py' <md_path> <pdf_path>
Then render PDF pages to PNG using PyMuPDF (2x resolution) into C:\hermes-daily-YYYY-MM-DD-images\. The self-hosted image server on port 18765 is already running and serving from C:\hermes-daily-2026-06-10-v2-images\, so just copy new images there.
Then GET http://127.0.0.1:18765/ to fetch today's token. In your final response, include the 7 image URLs using the format: http://127.0.0.1:18765/img/page-XX.png?token=<TOKEN>
Final message format:
1. one-line title with date
2. PDF size + page count
3. Top 3 highlights as bullets
4. Markdown path, PDF path, image directory path
5. Token-protected image URLs
Do NOT skip renderer step or self-host server step.
